Adjacent paragraphs in a layout-table cell are separated rather than concatenated into one run of text

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper().setPropertyNamingStrategy(com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"compact_tables\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<table><tr><td><p><b>Alice Example</b></p><p><i>Customer Service</i></p></td><td>Logo</td></tr><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr></table>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
